crossRefs.note: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the…
Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw the young man that he was industrious, and he put him in…
When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over…
The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding:
The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

translations.web: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
translations.bsb: The hand of the diligent will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.
translations.kjv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
translations.asv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule; But the slothful shall be put under taskwork.
